type.description: The process path a task belongs to. REBIN tasks are not creatable through `POST /tasks` by HTTP-only callers in practice — they arrive via the WorkReleased Kafka event's rebin path (see the process-path catalogue) — but they exist in the task store and therefore appear in read-model responses alongside PICK/PACK/SLAM.
type.title: TaskType

cpt.description: Committed Processing Time — the deadline driving dispatch priority. `claimNext` always selects the earliest-CPT pending task a station qualifies for.

orderRef.description: The originating order/work-unit reference (opaque to this service). Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities a claiming station's capability set must be a superset of. This is an open, freeform list of strings, not a closed enum — known values in active use include `pick`, `pack`, `slam`, and `hazmat` (hazmat is matched by the same generic capability-set mechanism as any other value; no special handling exists or is needed for it).

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty capability string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

fragile.description: A packing hint, not a placement or capability-matching signal: true if this task's upstream order line was classified Fragile by inventory-storage's ProductClassification concept, as stamped onto the WorkReleased event by wes-work-planning at release time. Optional and defaults to false for backward compatibility with any producer that predates this field; an explicit null is accepted and treated the same as omission (false).
